scripts.still: bun build.ts && slopcamera html still --input out/scene.json --at 3,7,11,15.5,19.5,24,28.5,33,37,41.5 --output out/stills
scripts.still:portrait: bun build.ts --aspect 9:16 && slopcamera html still --input out/9x16/scene.json --at 3,7,11,15.5,19.5,24,28.5,33,37,41.5 --output out/9x16/stills
scripts.render: bun build.ts && slopcamera html render --input out/scene.json --json > out/export.json
scripts.render:portrait: bun build.ts --aspect 9:16 && slopcamera html render --input out/9x16/scene.json --json > out/9x16/export.json
scripts.deliver: slopcamera html deliver out/export.json --basename introducing-valhalla --poster-at 24 --social-at 24 --cuts 1:1 --beats out/beats.json --per-beat-clips --output out/deliver
scripts.deliver:portrait: slopcamera html deliver out/9x16/export.json --basename introducing-valhalla-vertical --poster-at 24 --social-at 24 --beats out/9x16/beats.json --per-beat-clips --output out/deliver-vertical
